work.jaymoskingdoms.pack.title: Hunt: a Pack Near Town %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.pack.notice: Paid work. A pack has settled near town. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.pack.text: There's a pack of %2$s gone to ground out past %3$s, %1$s of them by the last count. Nobody will graze near it. Kill every one and come back to me.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.title: Wanted Dead: One With a Name %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.notice: Paid work, and dangerous. One named killer, somewhere out there. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.text: They call it %6$s. It has killed three of ours and it isn't afraid of a spear. Find it out past %3$s and end it. Don't go half ready: the ones it lets run, it comes after.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.taunt.0: Another one. They keep sending them, and I keep the boots.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.taunt.1: %1$s, is it? I'll know the name. I know all of them.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.taunt.2: You came a long way to lie down here.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.taunt.3: Did they tell you what happened to the last?
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.hurt.0: Good. Good! It's been a while.
work.jaymoskingdoms.elite.hurt.2: You'll have to do that again. Can you?
work.jaymoskingdoms.defend.title: Hold the Town Tonight %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.defend.notice: Paid work. They are coming for the town after dark. Pull it off the board to stand with us.
work.jaymoskingdoms.defend.text: They've been seen gathering, and they'll come at %3$s after dark: %1$s times, if they keep to their habit. Be here at nightfall and stand with the guard till it's over. Leave, and it's all on us.
work.jaymoskingdoms.defend.thanks.0: That's the one who held the gate with us. %1$s! You'll not buy a drink here again.
work.jaymoskingdoms.defend.thanks.1: My children slept through it, %1$s. All of it. That's your doing.
work.jaymoskingdoms.defend.thanks.2: I counted them in the morning, %1$s. I'd not have liked to count them alone.
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.title: A Traveller Wants Company on the Road %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.notice: Paid work. Someone needs seeing safe to another town. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.text: %6$s has to be in %3$s and won't walk the road alone, and I don't blame them. Go with them, on foot or with a cart, and see them there alive. They're waiting by me now.
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.arrived.0: There it is. I never thought I'd be glad to see that roof. Thank you.
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.arrived.1: We're here. You can stop looking over your shoulder now. So can I.
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.arrived.2: Safe. I'll tell them who walked me in.
work.jaymoskingdoms.trek.ambush: There, in the trees! They were waiting for us!
work.jaymoskingdoms.incursion.title: Something Has Dug In Near Town %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.incursion.notice: Paid work. Something has made a home too close to ours. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.incursion.nest.text: Spiders have webbed up a hollow out past %3$s, and it grows by the week. Kill what's in it, then burn the webs or cut them down, every one, or they'll be back by the new moon.
work.jaymoskingdoms.incursion.camp.text: Raiders have lit a fire out past %3$s, close enough that we smell it. That's no hunting camp. Kill them all before they've counted our doors.
work.jaymoskingdoms.incursion.pit.text: The ground has soured out past %3$s and the dead are coming up through it. Put down every one that walks there.
work.jaymoskingdoms.incursion.burn: Burn out the webs, or cut them down
work.jaymoskingdoms.lamps.title: Light the Dark Corners %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.lamps.notice: Paid work. The town has dark corners, and things come out of them. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.lamps.text: There are %1$s corners of %3$s where no light reaches, and that's where they come from at night. Set a torch or a lantern at each before nightfall. You'll see which when you walk the town.
work.jaymoskingdoms.lamps.objective: Light the dark corners: %1$s of %2$s, before nightfall
work.jaymoskingdoms.build.title: Hands Wanted to Build %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.build.notice: Paid work. Something needs building just outside town. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.build.text: We need %1$s %2$s set up at the marked ground just outside %3$s, and none of us has the days to spare. Bring your own and build it there. I'll walk out and count when you say it's done.
work.jaymoskingdoms.build.objective: Build at the marked ground: %1$s of %2$s %3$s
work.jaymoskingdoms.blast.title: A Cave-In to Blast Clear %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.blast.notice: Paid work. A fall of rock wants blasting. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.blast.text: The way's come down out past %3$s. We've dug at it and more falls as fast as we clear it. It wants powder: blast it open and it'll hold.
work.jaymoskingdoms.blast.more: More rock comes down as fast as it's dug. It needs blasting.
work.jaymoskingdoms.stash.title: Something to Leave in a Chest %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.stash.notice: Paid work. Goods to be left where they'll be found. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.stash.hermit.text: There's an old one living out past %3$s who won't come in and won't take charity to their face. Leave %1$s %2$s in the chest by their place. They'll find it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.stash.drop.text: No names. There's a chest out past %3$s. Put %1$s %2$s in it, close the lid, and walk away. You weren't there, and neither was I.
work.jaymoskingdoms.stash.shrine.text: The wayside shrine out past %3$s has had nothing left at it since the frost. Put %1$s %2$s in its chest for me. My knees won't take the walk.
work.jaymoskingdoms.stash.objective: Leave it in the chest: %1$s of %2$s %3$s
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.fallen: The one who rang the bell has fallen. The town is lost tonight.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.charge: The one you were walking with is dead.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.left: You left the town to it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.dark: Night fell with the corners still dark.
